stem.text: When performing an experiment, a student should minimise the uncertainty of any measurement.
In which case is the student reducing the systematic error in a measurement?

A.text: adjusting a voltmeter needle pointer to the zero position before using it to measure a potential difference

B.text: measuring the diameter of a wire at several points and orientations

C.text: measuring the mass of 100 paperclips to determine the mass of one paperclip

D.text: timing 20 oscillations of a mass on a spring to determine the period of one oscillation
